description: HIKOKI DS12DF - Cordless Driver Drill, 12V With 10mm Keyless Drill Chuck, Brushless Motor, 2 Speed Gear, 35 Nm Tightening Torque, Built-In Led Light, 1 Kg, 2 Batteries, Charger & Carry Case Included - Distributed/Packaged by Hikoki. Product Details: Efficient Brushless Motor: The advanced brushless motor provides greater efficiency and extended runtime compared to brushed models. With reduced friction and heat, it delivers reliable performance and requires less maintenance. 20-Stage Clutch, LED Light & Keyless Chuck: Enjoy precise torque control with the 20-stage clutch, perfect for different materials and applications. The keyless chuck allows fast, tool-free bit changes, keeping workflow smooth. Slide-Type Li-Ion Battery with Fast Charging: Compatible with 1.5–4.0Ah lithium-ion batteries, offering both lightweight portability and extended runtime. The UC12SL fast charger reduces downtime so your drill is always ready. Lightweight & Compact Design: Weighing only around 1.1 kg with a smaller battery, the drill is easy to handle and reduces fatigue. Its ergonomic design makes it ideal for extended use and overhead work. Smart Battery Status Indicator: Select batteries include an LED status indicator for quick monitoring of charge levels. It also alerts you to overheating or potential faults, helping you avoid interruptions.
